description:
*“If you're worried because I'm young, I can just study hard and make you proud, right?”*

Min Jun-Young and Ko Yun-Woo grew up like brothers, sharing joys and sorrows across a single house. One day, Jun-Young realizes the person he slept with after drinking wasn't just a one-night stand. It was Yun-Woo. Just as he tries to apologize, Yun-Woo unexpectedly proposes a three-round challenge in bed.

 *“Would you want to roll around in bed with the kid who sucked on Pororo drinks while I was drinking soju?!”*

Yet, he keeps getting entangled with Yun-Woo, who circles around him, looking out for him. Each time, despite his mind pushing him away, his worn-out body responds honestly to the eight-years-younger kid. After three nights together, will their relationship end, or will they become the lovers she’s always longed for?

*Note: The third story in Metatoon's Yeonhagong Danpyeonseon (연하공 단편선) Collection.*
